scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Sunday's twilight courtyard puppet walk feasible for the ticketed pair without relying on mobile-only gate scanning.
Emerging Need: Public entry rules are only background until the outing becomes confirmed and paid; the ticket confirmation then shows the needed printable companion pass has not been issued.
Decision Context: Stored preference records explain why Paloma needs paper admission when available, while the confirmation provides order details, request channel, and same-day cutoff.
Consequence: Timely handling can secure the missing entry prerequisite for the future arrival; after the print window closes, the outing remains scheduled but that support can no longer be added.

parameter.subject: Sunday twilight puppet-walk entry notes
parameter.body: Tomorrow's Railyard Courtyard twilight puppet walk uses the after-hours gate on Paseo de la Feria. Mobile QR entry is standard. Print-at-home gate pass requests are available only after ticket purchase through the confirmation reply path and close Saturday, September 26 at 3:00 PM.

parameter.content: That twilight puppet walk sounds lovely. If you decide to get the Sunday pair, I can meet you by the Railyard water tower at 6:10 and walk over together.

parameter.title: Twilight courtyard puppet walk with Paloma
parameter.description: Meet Paloma near the Railyard water tower at 6:10, then use after-hours gate for the courtyard puppet walk.
parameter.location: Railyard Courtyard, Paseo de la Feria gate

parameter.description: Two Sunday twilight puppet-walk admissions; email confirmation to follow.

parameter.subject: Order PCW-9137: two twilight puppet-walk admissions
parameter.body: Thank you for your purchase. Order PCW-9137 includes two mobile QR admissions for Sunday, September 27, 6:30 PM. Printable gate pass status: not requested. If a print-at-home pass is needed for either guest, reply to passes@railyardcourtyard.example by 3:00 PM today with the order number and guest name. After the deadline, Sunday twilight entries remain mobile QR only at the after-hours gate.

parameter.subject: Print-at-home gate pass window closed for Sunday twilight walk
parameter.body: The 3:00 PM print-at-home gate pass window has closed for Sunday's twilight puppet walk. Order PCW-9137 remains set for two mobile QR admissions only. No will-call or print-at-home substitutions can be added for tomorrow's after-hours gate.
